The Exim share is not stated. The final section went to Russia's state railway company on a Russian loan.

companies.name: China Railway International and China Communications Construction Company (CRIC-CCCC)

conditions: The Chinese consortium was selected before the loan agreements were final, under a July 2018 commercial contract covering the Novi Sad–Subotica section, which includes the station. CHOICE says such contracts were not accessible, while linking an archived copy of this one.
